# Optional Agent Role Drafts

Stand: 2026-06-17  
Status: HISTORICAL / OPTIONAL

This folder is intentionally optional. Do not rely on these files unless the chosen agent toolchain supports repo-local agent definitions.

Suggested roles:

- life-os-product-designer
- life-os-design-reviewer
- life-os-accessibility-reviewer
- life-os-security-reviewer

For now, canonical instructions remain in:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `AI_WORKFLOW.md`

The `.github/instructions/*` files are thin non-canonical tool adapters. The old `.github/prompts/*` task library was removed after the GitHub Issue/Project cutover; reusable task method now lives in `AI_WORKFLOW.md` and `.agents/skills/**`. This folder remains optional historical role material and must not act as an independent product, workflow or roadmap authority.
